annotation.title_clean: Unmanned Aircraft Systems Research, Development, Regulation, and Privacy Act of 2015 (Senate Bill 370)
annotation.title_en: Unmanned Aircraft Systems Research, Development, Regulation, and Privacy Act of 2015 (Senate Bill 370)
annotation.summary_en: Maryland enrolled Senate Bill 370 (2015) makes the State the sole regulator of drone testing and operation, preempting county and municipal rules. It directs state agencies to study drone benefits and privacy and safety concerns, monitor FAA rulemaking, and review recreational drone misuse, reporting to the legislature.
key_provisions_or_claims: Only the State may prohibit, restrict or regulate UAS testing/operation; county and municipal laws are preempted and superseded.
Federal preemption of State law is unaffected.
Dept. of Business and Economic Development must study UAS benefits, privacy and safety policies, and report by Dec 31, 2015.
State agencies must monitor FAA small UAS rulemaking and assess whether state legislation is warranted.
State Police, MAA and local officials must review recreational UAS misuse and report by Dec 31, 2018.
